Upper Text: Digivolve: 9 from Lv.5 w/＜Save＞ in text
[When Digivolving] Suspend all other Digimon and all Tamers. Then, for every 2 suspended Digimon and/or Tamers, gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] Other than this Digimon, all Digimon and Tamers don't unsuspend.
[When Attacking] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, trash the top card of your opponent’s security stack for every 5 suspended Digimon and/or Tamers.
